pages.text: I gave the Chronocortex the heart. It knew it: it was its own. It made a $(l)pump$() of it in brass. Grafted onto a $(l)level 3 Enhancing Gland$(), it drives the essence deeper than any gland can swell, to a depth a body is not meant to hold. There, one power of each essence wakes.

pages.title: What Wakes
pages.text: $(l)Collapse$() (Density): crushing weight where I look; all near falls in.$(br)$(l)Slip$() (Speed): step between moments to where I look.$(br)$(l)Writhe$() (Size): tentacles burst from the ground round me.$(br)$(l)Thousand Eyes$() (Awareness): all that lives near glows through stone; nothing blinds me.$(br)$(l)Aeon$() (Time): what I look at lives an aeon in a moment.
